contexts.full_loo: candidate is added to the other nine A10 actions
contexts.core_boundary: core action is retained/dropped; outside action is added to the frozen QTTS+F10+B10 core

screen_modes.candidate_head_oof200: old-action heads use 2000 training prompts outside the calibration block; only the candidate head uses 200-prompt nested OOF predictions
screen_modes.all_heads_oof200: conservative from-scratch control: every action head uses only the 200-prompt nested OOF block

rules.router_mean_block0: block-0 Oracle delta > 0 and OOF Router mean delta > 0
rules.router_lcb_block0: block-0 Oracle delta > 0 and paired-bootstrap Router 95% lower bound > 0
rules.router_mean_stable_3of3: Oracle and OOF Router mean deltas > 0 in all three blocks
rules.router_lcb_majority_2of3: Oracle delta > 0 in all blocks and Router lower bound > 0 in at least two blocks

notes: The cheap screen fits Ridge only within each 200-prompt block.
The 800 test labels never affect an admission decision.
Test routing uses the existing full-data Ridge prediction caches, so test deltas represent post-admission deployment after normal router training.
Marginal value is context-dependent; full-LOO and core-boundary results should not be interpreted as context-free action scores.
